covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Friday, November 6, 2026 market close and before the Monday, November 9, 2026 market open
market_context_summary: Risk appetite remains fragile after Thursday's 4.4% S&P 500 drop and AI-led selloff; Friday brought a narrow tech rebound, while October payrolls rose 165,000 versus roughly 65,000 expected and lifted rate sensitivity.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Alternative net flows; AUM; economic EPS
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record AUM, strong alternative-strategy inflows, and rapid economic-EPS growth favor upside if flow quality persists.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $8.70; the decisive test is whether record alternative inflows and fee-related earnings remain durable.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Alternative inflows, higher AUM, and buybacks lift economic EPS.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Equity-market weakness and differentiated long-only outflows dilute the headline AUM gain.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options indicated roughly 2.5% to the nearest expiry, while a longer Nov. 20 estimate was about 7.7%; use cautiously because expiries differ.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The published $8.70 EPS bar follows Q2 economic EPS of $8.29 and record AUM; no reliable broad revision series was public.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record fee-related earnings and double-digit fee-paying AUM growth support upside if fundraising and monetization remain resilient.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $1.58 versus a $1.56 whisper; the stock therefore needs durable FRE and capital formation more than a headline EPS beat.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FRE growth, fundraising and realizations stay strong.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Muted exits, insurance volatility, or weaker fundraising offset fee growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options price about a 6.3%-7.0% move, above the recent roughly 2.4% average earnings move cited by one calendar source.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The whisper sits $0.02 below consensus, so there is no visible unpublished EPS premium; operating KPIs carry more weight.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Higher production, strong gold economics, lower capex guidance, and capital returns support upside if AISC remains controlled.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is $0.74 EPS and $5.08 billion revenue; the market is more likely to focus on output, AISC, cash conversion and the North American IPO.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Production beats plan, AISC stays in range, and shareholder returns remain strong.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Fuel, royalties or Mali-related costs erode cash conversion despite high gold prices.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 5.8%-7.6%, a meaningful bar for a miner whose last post-report drift was modestly negative.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No reliable broad revision series was public; consensus is below Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.82, leaving a manageable headline bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Near-term charter coverage and contracted cash flows support upside if newbuild funding and forward rates remain disciplined.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.32 EPS and $189 million revenue; coverage is 100% for 2026 and 90% for 2027, shifting attention to forward chartering and capital commitments.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Firm charters, contract cover and dividend support outweigh fleet-renewal spending.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Newbuild leverage or weakening charter rates reduces the value of contracted cash flows.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options indicate about a 4.8% move; the stock had fallen roughly 11% from its prior-earnings anchored average price.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The $2.42 whisper is $0.10 above the $2.32 consensus, modestly raising the beat bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record EBITDA, very high compression utilization, and raised guidance favor upside if power-infrastructure execution remains credible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is $0.64 EPS and $387 million revenue; EBITDA and utilization are more decision-useful than EPS because of acquisition and depreciation effects.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Compression stays above 98% utilized and power projects convert to contracted cash flow.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Power deployments slip, capex rises, or the EPS miss narrative dominates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No sufficiently reliable public implied-move estimate was found; shares were roughly 28% below the prior earnings-anchored average price, indicating substantial de-risking.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 raised EBITDA and discretionary-cash-flow guidance; the current EPS bar remains sensitive to financing and depreciation.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Raised GTV guidance and strong automotive volumes support upside, tempered by service take-rate compression.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $0.99 versus a $1.04 whisper; GTV and service take rate are the decisive metrics.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GTV remains near double-digit growth and take-rate pressure stabilizes.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: HE&T volumes weaken and mix drives further take-rate compression.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were about 10% above the prior earnings-anchored average price, raising the expectation bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The whisper is $0.05 above consensus and management already raised GTV growth guidance.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Share gains and non-residential strength create a modest upside edge if gross margin holds despite soft housing.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is $3.28 versus a $3.36 whisper; organic growth and margin quality matter more than acquisition-supported sales.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Non-residential strength and share gains offset subdued residential demand.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Residential weakness and gross-margin pressure overwhelm acquisition growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 8.5%, above the cited 10-year average near 6.5%, setting a demanding magnitude bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The whisper is $0.08 above consensus after management lifted guidance in Q2.
